name: PearBrowser public site
description: Static public and Hyperdrive-ready website for PearBrowser, the private desktop browser for the regular and peer-to-peer web with native hyper:// browsing, verified apps, publishing, and local-first data.

privacy.tor: optional HiveRelay transport exists; PearBrowser Desktop does not route through Tor automatically

webSearch.surface: browser-owned active first tab and blank new tabs
webSearch.providerReceives: query and network address needed to return results

hyperdrive.availabilityBoundary: reachable only while at least one peer or accepted relay carrying the bytes is online
hyperdrive.contentBoundary: A fresh-peer read on 2026-09-28 found website v0.7.1 at the advertised key. The current HTTPS v0.9.0 source is not published there.

distribution.status: SHA-256-verifiable package-proof builds are published for v0.9.0 on macOS, Windows, and Linux. macOS is ad-hoc signed but not notarized, Windows is unsigned, and public-trust delivery remains a separate gate. P2P app cookies are not isolated between drives on the shared loopback host.

knownLimitations.p2pAppCookies: Different P2P drive ports on 127.0.0.1 share Electron host cookies; v0.9.0 does not provide per-drive cookie isolation.

desktopSource.downloadBoundary: v0.9.0 is the latest published desktop download. v0.9.1 is a draft Pear 3.4/Autobee compatibility candidate. Its distinct-host fix passed a local macOS Electron cookie probe; real P2P app cookie-isolation capture in the packaged app, clean-install validation, and public-trust signing remain open.

checks: release metadata matches the approved public native-release record
local page, asset, and anchor links resolve
manifest release, source/runtime status, installer URL, legacy migration record, and Hyperdrive keys match the public HTML
privacy copy, structured data, social metadata, sitemap, robots, and AI discovery files stay consistent
